notes.title: Update 2: Long Term Car Rental
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24


[h2]Hello Car Traders![/h2]

Now you can rent your cars for more than 1 day.

Go to the [b]Licenses[/b] section on your [b]office computer[/b] and buy the [b]Long Term Rental license[/b]. And now the customers who come to your rental cars will make you offers for longer rentals.

* If you loaded the game with a save before the update, this license will be added to your game automatically. You will be able to rent for more than 1 day automatically. If you start a new game, you should buy this license :)

[h2]Next Update: Tuning for Drift Cars[/h2]

We are preparing the Tuning Garage primarily to bring new styles to Drift cars. The next update will be next week. Get ready to give new styles to your Drift cars.

[h3]Thank you on behalf of Rent A Car Simulator 24![/h3]

notes.title: Update 1: Are you ready for a new race car?
notes.content:
Here is the first update released for Rent A Car Simulator 24

[h2]A new Race Car class car: Suparama Race Car[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/d73455613398633cd66987fd7e8121a20491a627.png[/img]

You can only get the new Suparama Race Car from the car auction and the chances are low. You may have to go to the auction a few days in a row to get it.

* The cars in the new Race Car category drive differently than daily cars and Drift Cars. Their acceleration is quite high.


[h2]Is anyone hungry?[/h2]

Vendors are coming to the world of Rent A Car Simulator 24 for many of your needs. 

Perhaps one of your most important needs (!), the Hot Dog Vendor, is waiting for you right around the corner from your home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/fc7154b1cefd531fc2e7c8d744c7f66fd1440aeb.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

* Fixed issue where cars in high-rise offices would appear outside.

* Vehicle repair prices have been adjusted.

* Car spawn frequency has been adjusted. Cars now spawn more frequently.

* If you are stuck anywhere on the map, you can teleport to the office with Shift + Alt + T

This shortcut will be available as a button in the next update.

notes.title: Rent A Car Simulator 24 - Out Now !
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


[h3]Hello Car Traders![/h3]

Rent A Car Simulator 24 Early Access Out Now !

Here are some brand new features:

[h3]New Auction Hall building and Car Auctions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44952515/0732e852c360c177ddc62647c16f03aed35af3de.png[/img]


[h3]Airport and Airplane system[/h3]

We now have an Airport.
Planes that operate continuously, landing and taking off from the airport have been added.
You can see planes in the sky while buying, selling and renting cars in town.
At the same time, you can go to the airport and challenge a plane coming towards you.

You will be able to buy all of the houses in the world of Rent A Car Simulator 24. This means that you can be the sole ruler of the town where the game takes place 🙂
There are 2 options for the houses you purchase;
You can use it as a house and furnish it with your belongings.
If you want, you can demolish your house, turn it into a parking area and park your vehicles there.

notes.title: New Drift Car!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


As we continue to develop the full version of Rent A Car Simulator 24, we present you a new rare drfit car.

[h3]Pegasus Drift Car[/h3]

Pegasus Drift car is the most difficult car to control, but it is the car with which you can get the highest drift scores. It can skid perfectly on special tracks that we will prepare for drifting, especially on sharp turns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44952515/97f65553db8ec9acf72246c4d233c6085eb9b9f5.jpg[/img]

The suspension level is quite high compared to all other cars.

The Pegasus Drift Car is a rare find and can only be purchased at car auctions with a low chance.

We are adding brand new locations to the game world and improving the world. We will share map improvements with you in our new updates.

notes.title: Play Co-Op at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


[h3]Hello Car Investors![/h3]

Thank you very much for playing the Rent A Car Simulator 24 Prologue version for the past 2 months.

Our Youtuber friends shot many videos. Thanks to everyone for the over 500 individual videos and over 1.5 million unique views we can count.

[h3]Now is the Time to Play Co-Op[/h3]

Rent A Car Simulator 24 was developed in Co-Op from the beginning. And you'll finally be able to try it out in Prologue and Demo versions at Steam Next Fest June 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44952515/a6c1486ad47308429d39a4b5656102d9b4a0e174.png[/img]

[h3]What does Co-Op Gameplay Content include?[/h3]

Everything!

Rent Together
Buy Together
Build Together

Manage Your Rent A Car Company Together

Not enough?

Drift Together!

You can play the entire game - all its features - Co-Op with your friends on Steam, establish your Rent A Car company together, build high-rise offices and rent and buy and sell your cars.

This is a brand new way of playing and we are sure you will have a lot of fun.

[b]The Co-Op feature will be available for Prologue and Demo version of the game when Steam Next Fest: June 2024 begins.[/b]

Update your games as soon as the festival starts, we are waiting for you to join in the fun!

tags.feature: The Co-Op feature will be available for Prologue and Demo version of the game when Steam Next Fest: June 2024 begins.

notes.title: Introducing The Building System
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


[h3]Hello Car Investors![/h3]

We have new news for you from the development stages of Rent A Car Simulator 24.

[h3]Introducing The Building System[/h3]

In Rent A Car Simulator 24, it is up to you to build your office the way you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44952515/6b472aec817dc31dbe9443f3838d2b41216b9424.png[/img]

With the detailed construction system, you can build a large single-storey office or a 10-storey plaza.

From an FPS perspective; Build glass frames, walls, stairs and all bilding parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44952515/12c31279f5ca7103da0b367fa469bdcef6bc61c8.png[/img]

You can arrange your cars in the offices you have built and invite your customers to come to your office.

We are developing an elevator to take your cars to the upper floors of your office. You will also have a lot of furniture and items to decorate your office (or maybe your plaza).

* Rent A Car Simulator 24 Construction and Decoration System is fully multiplayer compatible. We seem to see that great offices will be built while playing together.


[h3]Newly added Languages[/h3]

* Added German language translation.
* Added Portuguese language translation.
* Added Russian language translation.


[h3]Some videos from Youtube about Rent A Car Simulator 24[/h3]
* Thanks to our Youtuber friends.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c6rF-jMIyTU

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q2bLgHhI6i0


[h3]Add To Wishlist[/h3]

Add to wishlist and follow to keep up with the game and support us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

notes.title: Rent A Car Simulator 24: Licenses and New Cars
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


[h2]Hello Car Traders![/h2]

We have new news for you from the development stages of Rent A Car Simulator 24.

[h3]Introducing Licence System[/h3]

Licenses section has been added to your office computer. 

In order to sell and sell cars in New Car Markets, you need to obtain the relevant licenses.

[h3]There are multiple car markets in Rent A Car Simulator 24[/h3]

You will be able to find vehicles with different features and types in each Car Market.
In this update, we have prepared Car Market Tier 2 for you.
In this Car Market, you can buy 6 new cars and an additional lorry.

You will be able to buy and sell cars in this new market by obtaining the Car Market Tier 2 License from your office computer.

[h3]New Cars[/h3]

6 new cars and a lorry have been added to Rent A Car Simulator 24.

notes.title: Rent A Car Simulator 24: Prologue has been released
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2898250/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24_Prologue/


[h3]Hello![/h3]

[b]Rent A Car Simulator 24: Prologue[/b] is a [b]free[/b] limited version of the full game so you can stop waiting and start running your Rent A Car Business now. Don't forget to add the full version of the game to your wishlist to continue your most entertaining Rent A Car experience.

Some of the things you can do in this version:

* Renting your vehicles to customers and tracking their rental status.

* Buy new cars and grow your car rental business.

*Earn income by selling your cars.

* You can repair cars.


[h3]Add to Wishlist[/h3]

To follow the game and support us, add it to the wish list and follow it.
